mentions.name: Verva
mentions.description: Language learning app that teaches through reading current news and other content with the guidance of an AI tutor, generating lessons and exercises targeted at the gaps the reading uncovers. Released this week on the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Language learning by reading today’s news (and more) with the guidance of an AI tutor. Get lessons and exercises for the gaps this uncovers.

Just released this week on to the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/verva-language-learning/id6755181586
